description:
About the job

We're hiring a TikTok Shop Affiliate Manager to join Sophie Society's TikTok Shop team. This is a junior-level role focused on building genuine relationships with affiliates and growing the creator communities for the brands we manage on TikTok Shop. Most of these brands are US-based, so all creator-facing communication happens in English. The day-to-day is hands-on relationship work: finding creators, reaching out, onboarding them, keeping them active, and helping each brand's community grow.







What you'll do

Affiliate & Creator Relationships

Build and nurture relationships with TikTok Shop affiliates and creators across multiple US-based brands
Source and reach out to new creators with personalized messages (not generic or AI-generated)
Onboard new affiliates: walk them through the brand, the product, commissions, and how to get started
Re-engage dormant or inactive affiliates to bring them back into the program
Negotiate basic commission terms and coordinate sample/seeding shipments and follow-ups
Track creator activity: videos posted, GMV generated, views, and engagement

Community Growth

Grow and manage each brand's creator community (Discord and group chats)
Keep creators engaged through regular communication, challenges, contests, and shoutouts
Run monthly creator challenges and incentive campaigns, including bonus tracking
Distribute creator briefs and keep creators aligned on content direction and promos

Coordination & Reporting

Coordinate flash sales and time-sensitive promos with affiliates (notify, brief, activate)
Keep the creator CRM / tracker up to date
Provide weekly updates on creator activity, sample status, and GMV
Work closely with the wider TikTok Shop and Amazon teams to stay aligned with each brand's goals




Requirements:

Fluent, professional English (written and spoken)
Strong communication and relationship-building skills
Comfortable on TikTok and across social platforms
Organized and able to juggle multiple brands and workflows at once
Self-starter who can work independently in a remote setup
Reliable internet and some daily overlap with US business hours




Nice to have:

1+ year of experience as a community manager. Not a hard requirement, but a real differentiator
Experience with TikTok Shop, affiliate programs, or creator/influencer marketing
Experience managing Discord or other creator communities
E-commerce / DTC / Amazon brand background
Spanish & English speaker (most of our team is LATAM-based)
Familiarity with tools like Notion, Slack, Cruva, and Kalodata

About the job

About the Project:

Where Winds Meet is an epic open-world action-adventure RPG rooted in the rich legacy of Wuxia.

Set during the turbulent era of tenth-century China, you take on the role of a young sword master, uncovering forgotten truths and the mysteries of your own identity.

About The Role

We are looking for a passionate and creative Social Media Content Intern to join our Global Marketing team. In this role, you will support social media content planning, trend monitoring, and community-focused initiatives across key platforms including X (Twitter), TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Discord, and Reddit.

You will work closely with the User Growth team to identify emerging trends, explore content opportunities, and help develop engaging social media campaigns that resonate with gaming audiences worldwide.

Responsibilities

Social Media Trend Monitoring


Monitor social media platforms including X (Twitter), TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, and Discord to identify emerging trends, viral content formats, and relevant gaming conversations.
Track platform updates, creator activities, and audience interests within gaming communities.


Content Research & Ideation


Support content planning by researching social media trends, gaming culture, internet memes, and entertainment topics.
Assist in brainstorming content ideas and campaign concepts tailored for gaming audiences.
Identify timely opportunities to connect game content with broader social media conversations.


Influencer & Community Research


Research gaming creators, influencers, streamers, and community trends across English Community.
Monitor competitor and industry social channels to identify best practices and content opportunities.
Support influencer and community-related initiatives as needed.


Social Media Operations


Assist with content calendar management, publishing coordination, and campaign tracking.
Support the preparation of social media copy, screenshots, and other platform assets.
Help collect and organize performance data from social media campaigns.
Support the development and execution of localized social media initiatives for English-speaking audiences, ensuring content is culturally relevant, engaging, and aligned with community interests.
Review social content and community communications from a cultural sensitivity perspective, helping ensure messaging is appropriate and well received by audiences.


Performance Analysis


Monitor content performance and engagement metrics.
Assist in preparing reports and identifying content trends, audience preferences, and optimization opportunities.


Requirements


Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Media, Business, Social Sciences or a related field.
Passion for video games, with a strong interest in action RPGs, open-world games, and online gaming communities. Familiarity with Where Winds Meet or the Wuxia genre is highly desirable.
Active user of social media platforms such as TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, and X (Twitter).

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
About the job

Job Title: Marketing Project Coordinator




About the Company:

Our client is a dynamic organization focused on innovative marketing solutions and operational excellence.




Job Description:

The Marketing Project Coordinator will assist executive leadership with day-to-day marketing and operational projects. This role involves creating project briefs, coordinating projects across various teams, and maintaining project timelines and deliverables.

The ideal candidate will also organize digital assets, assist with website content updates, and manage social media accounts while ensuring projects remain on schedule.




Responsibilities of the role:

• Assist executive leadership with day-to-day marketing and operational projects.

• Create project briefs, creative briefs, and implementation documents.

• Coordinate projects between marketing teams, developers, designers, agencies, and contractors.

• Maintain project timelines, deadlines, and deliverables.

• Follow up with team members to ensure projects remain on schedule.

• Organize, maintain, and distribute digital assets including graphics, videos, product images, marketing materials, and creative files.

• Maintain organized cloud storage and asset management systems.

• Assist with website content updates and marketing initiatives.

• Schedule, update, and maintain social media accounts.

• Coordinate social media content calendars and publishing schedules.

• Pull and organize performance reports from advertising and social media platforms.

• Assist with launch planning for products, campaigns, promotions, and website updates.

• Research, review, audit, and evaluate new software platforms, AI tools, marketing tools, design tools, automation systems, and development solutions.

• Create and maintain SOPs, process documentation, and workflow procedures.

• Support reporting, analytics, and executive project initiatives.

• Participate in team meetings and provide project status updates.




Required Experience and Qualifications:

• Minimum 3 years of recent experience within the last 3 years supporting marketing, social media, project management, operations, or digital business functions.

• Hands-on experience with TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest, Reddit, and YouTube.

• Experience coordinating projects involving multiple departments.

• Experience creating project briefs and task documentation.

• Strong organizational and time-management skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Strong Microsoft Office proficiency.

• Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities.




Preferred Skills:

• Meta Ads Manager.

• TikTok Ads Manager.

• Pinterest Ads.

• Google Ads.

• Shopify.

• GA4.

• Looker Studio.

• Canva.

• AI tools and workflow automation platforms.




Personality:

• Highly organized and detail-oriented.

• Strong follow-up and accountability.

• Comfortable working directly with executive leadership.

• Able to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

• Process-driven and proactive.

• Strong problem-solving skills.

• Comfortable working with marketing, design, development, and operations teams.




Software & Tools:

• Experience with Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Pinterest Ads, Google Ads, Shopify, Google Analytics, and various social media platforms.




Schedule:

Full-time position.




Salary and Benefits:

• Payment in USD or Local Currency according to candidate's preference.

• Full-time remote opportunity.

Experiencia organizando eventos en conjunto con socios tecnológicos o de industria.
Nociones de diseño o producción audiovisual.
Experiencia previa en la industria tech, software o B2B.

title: Spanish Speakers - Online Data Analyst (Part-time)
description:
About the job

¿Eres una persona orientada a los detalles con pasión por la investigación y una buena comprensión de la geografía nacional y local? Esta oportunidad de trabajo independiente te permite trabajar a tu propio ritmo y desde la comodidad de tu hogar.




Un Día en la Vida de un Analista de Datos en Línea:

En este rol, trabajarás en un proyecto destinado a mejorar el contenido y la calidad de los mapas digitales que utilizan millones de personas en todo el mundo. Completar tareas de investigación y evaluación en un entorno basado en web, como verificar y comparar datos, y determinar la relevancia y precisión de la información.

¡Únete a nosotros hoy y sé parte de un equipo dinámico e innovador que está marcando la diferencia en el mundo!




TELUS Digital AI Community

Nuestra Comunidad Global de IA es una red vibrante de más de 1 millón de colaboradores de diversos orígenes que ayudan a nuestros clientes a recopilar, mejorar, entrenar, traducir y localizar contenido para construir mejores modelos de IA. Conviértete en parte de nuestra comunidad en crecimiento y haz un impacto apoyando los modelos de aprendizaje automático de algunas de las marcas más grandes del mundo.




Ruta de Calificación

No se requiere experiencia profesional previa para solicitar este rol; sin embargo, trabajar en este proyecto requerirá que pases los requisitos básicos y pases por un proceso de evaluación estándar. Este es un proyecto a tiempo parcial a largo plazo y tu trabajo estará sujeto a nuestras verificaciones estándar de control de calidad durante el término de este acuerdo.




Requisitos Básicos

Dominio Profesional Completo del inglés y español. Ser residente en México durante los últimos 5 años consecutivos y tener familiaridad con los asuntos comerciales, mediáticos, deportivos, de noticias, redes sociales y culturales actuales e históricos de México. Capacidad para seguir directrices y realizar investigaciones en línea utilizando motores de búsqueda, mapas en línea e información de sitios web. Flexibilidad para trabajar en una diversa gama de tipos de tareas, incluidos mapas, noticias, tareas de audio y relevancia Acceso diario a una conexión internet, computadora y software relevante.




Evaluación Para ser contratado en el programa: deberás realizar una evaluación técnica a libro abierto para validar tu perfil para el puesto, además de completar el proceso de verificación de identidad. Nuestro equipo te proporcionará directrices y materiales de aprendizaje antes de tu examen de calificación. Se te requerirá completar el examen en un plazo específico pero a tu conveniencia.




Igualdad de oportunidades: La selección de nuestros colaboradores se basa únicamente en las aptitudes profesionales. Garantizamos un proceso equitativo para todos los solicitantes, sin importar su raza, creencias, identidad, orientación sexual o capacidades diferentes.. En TELUS Digital AI, nos enorgullece ofrecer igualdad de oportunidades y estamos comprometidos con la creación de una comunidad diversa e inclusiva. Todos los aspectos de la selección se basan en las calificaciones, méritos, competencia y desempeño de los solicitantes sin importar ninguna característica relacionada con la diversidad.

title: Gerente de Marketing y CRM
description:
About the job

City Storage es una plataforma integrada de inversión, desarrollo y operación de autoalmacenaje, en plena fase de expansión en Ciudad de México.




Buscamos un Gerente de Marketing Digital que sea responsable end-to-end del proceso de generación, prospección y conversión de leads — desde la estrategia de campañas hasta la coordinación diaria con el equipo de ventas.




Este es un puesto operativo y estratégico a la vez: la persona ideal diseña el proceso de prospección, lo implementa en HubSpot, y monitorea su desempeño con datos — no solo ejecuta campañas.




Responsabilidades




Gestión del CRM HubSpot

- Ser el responsable directo de la administración del CRM HubSpot: configuración, calidad de datos, automatizaciones y reportes

- Asegurar que cada lead generado, sin importar el canal de origen, quede correctamente registrado y trackeado en el pipeline

- Mantener la higiene de datos del CRM y capacitar al equipo de ventas en su uso correcto




Diseño e Implementación del Proceso de Prospección

- Definir el proceso end-to-end de prospección de leads: desde la captura hasta la cita agendada con el equipo de ventas

- Implementar ese proceso dentro de HubSpot mediante flujos de trabajo, etapas de pipeline y automatizaciones

- Documentar el proceso para que sea replicable conforme se abran nuevas sucursales




Monitoreo y Contacto de Leads

- Supervisar el flujo de leads digitales desde su generación (campañas pagadas y orgánicas) hasta su clasificación por nivel de interés

- Contactar leads directamente o coordinar al equipo que lo haga, y agendar citas para el equipo de ventas

- Dar seguimiento a leads no contactados o estancados en el pipeline para evitar fugas de oportunidades




Campañas Digitales — Pagadas y Orgánicas

- Monitorear y coordinar las campañas digitales pagadas (Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads) en todas las sucursales activas con consultores externos

- Supervisar la estrategia de contenido orgánico y calendario editorial en redes sociales

- Analizar el desempeño de cada canal y reasignar presupuesto según resultados de conversión, no solo de alcance




Coordinación de Diseño Creativo

- Coordinar al consultor externo de diseño creativo para asegurar que el material de campañas esté alineado con la estrategia comercial y la identidad de marca

- Dar retroalimentación basada en datos de desempeño, no solo en preferencia estética

- Gestionar tiempos de entrega y prioridades creativas según el calendario de campañas




Dashboards, Metas y KPIs

- Diseñar y mantener dashboards de prospección que muestren el embudo completo: leads generados, contactados, citas agendadas, visitas y cierres

- Definir metas mensuales de prospección por sucursal y por canal, en conjunto con el equipo de ventas y operaciones

- Reportar resultados semanalmente a la dirección, identificando cuellos de botella en el embudo




Requisitos

- 3+ años de experiencia gestionando campañas digitales pagadas (Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads) con responsabilidad sobre presupuesto y ROI

- Experiencia comprobable usando HubSpot u otro CRM como herramienta central de gestión de leads — no solo como repositorio de contactos

- Experiencia diseñando o mejorando procesos de prospección de ventas, idealmente con automatizaciones

- Capacidad analítica: cómodo leyendo dashboards, definiendo KPIs y tomando decisiones basadas en datos de conversión, no solo de alcance o impresiones

- Experiencia coordinando proveedores o consultores externos (diseño, pauta, contenido)

- Español nativo o fluido; inglés profesional para trabajar con sistemas y reportes




Deseable

- Experiencia en real estate, o negocios con ciclo de venta corto y alto volumen de leads

- Certificaciones en Google Ads, Meta Blueprint, o HubSpot Academy

- Experiencia gestionando marketing para múltiples sucursales o ubicaciones simultáneamente




Cómo aplicar




Además de aplicar por LinkedIn, envía un correo a reclutamiento@citystorage.mx con el asunto 

"Gerente Marketing – [Tu Nombre]" adjuntando tu CV más reciente y respondiendo estas 2 preguntas breves (no hace falta carta de presentación formal, buscamos claridad y sustancia):




1. Describe brevemente un proceso de prospección o pipeline que hayas diseñado o mejorado 

 desde cero (no solo ejecutado).

2. ¿Qué automatización o flujo de trabajo has construido en un CRM? (ej. secuencias de 

 seguimiento, scoring de leads, alertas)




Candidatos que no envíen estas respuestas podrían no ser considerados en la primera ronda.




Palabras clave: Marketing Digital, HubSpot, CRM, Growth Marketing, Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Lead Generation, Marketing Automation, Real Estate, Self Storage

description:
About the job

Are you someone who thrives in high-expectation environments — someone who has built your career in places where the bar is high, the pace is fast, and excellence is the norm — and now wants to apply that same rigor to building and growing a portfolio of consumer brands?




We’re looking for a Brand Strategy & Growth Manager who pairs sharp commercial thinking with real instinct for brand, product, and consumer. This person can look across a portfolio of brands, identify the opportunities that will move them forward — whether in brand, product, marketing, or anywhere else growth is hiding — and drive the work from first idea to real results.




You’re sharp, resourceful, and reliable under pressure. You’ve likely spent the first 2–4 years of your career in a demanding, results-driven environment — consulting, a top tech or CPG company, a brand incubator, a high-growth consumer startup, or an equally rigorous organization — where structured thinking, accountability, and speed were expected. You have genuine taste and strong instincts for what makes a brand and product compelling, but you lead with commercial judgment: you’re a business person first, not a designer.




Now you’re looking to apply that intensity in a role with real ownership, variety, and visibility, working directly with the CEO.




This role is for someone who:

Brings structured, commercial thinking to brand, product, and growth decisions.
Has direct experience with consumer brands and understands how brand, product, marketing, and commercial performance connect.
Takes full ownership of a wide range of initiatives and figures out which ones are worth pursuing in the first place.
Moves fluidly between big-picture strategy and the hands-on details that make it real.
Has taste and a point of view, but grounds every creative instinct in business logic.
Thrives in an environment where the pace is fast and the standards are high.




If you want a role where you’ll work directly with the CEO across everything that grows our brands — and where your impact will be visible across the company — this is it.




The Role

You’ll report directly to the CEO and act as a force multiplier across the portfolio — the person we point at whatever will most improve our brands and drive growth.

Some of the work is brand: sharpening how a brand shows up and what it stands for. Some of it is product: spotting white space and leading a new launch from concept to shelf. Some of it is marketing: standing up the social, influencer, and campaign work that moves the needle. And plenty of it won’t fit neatly into any one of those buckets — a project to improve how we run a brand, a new process, a new asset, or an opportunity no one has spotted yet.

Your job is to find the highest-leverage work and go do it.




Key Responsibilities

Brand positioning & equity: Own how each brand shows up — what it stands for, how it’s positioned, and the messaging and consumer experience behind it.
Product development: Research the category and competitors, define the features that matter, push contract manufacturers and supply chain toward the right quality and cost, and take products from concept to shelf.
Marketing & growth: Identify the messaging, channels, and campaigns most likely to grow a brand — social, influencer, content, and beyond — then develop them and prove they moved the number.
Creative direction: Write copy yourself and direct the creative team on packaging, assets, and storytelling.
Opportunity identification: Pressure-test where the highest-leverage moves across the portfolio are, and build the case for what’s worth doing.
Whatever moves the needle: Take on high-priority projects across the business — wherever sharp thinking and real ownership will drive growth.




Requirements

2–4 years of experience in a high-expectation, analytical, and execution-driven environment, such as consulting, investment banking, private equity, consumer tech, CPG, a brand incubator, a high-growth consumer startup, or an equally rigorous organization.
Direct experience with consumer brands, ideally across beauty, wellness, home, Amazon / marketplace businesses, retail, e-commerce, or another fast-moving consumer category.
Strong commercial judgment and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down ambiguous problems, identify high-leverage opportunities, and turn ideas into clear action plans.
Experience launching, scaling, or improving brand, product, marketing, content, or e-commerce growth initiatives.
Strong brand, product, and consumer instincts, with an eye for what makes products, messaging, campaigns, packaging, and creative commercially effective.
Demonstrated ability to own projects end-to-end, from research and analysis through execution, follow-up, and measurement of results.
Excellent written communication skills, including the ability to write clear recommendations, briefs, copy, internal updates, and executive-ready summaries.
High ownership, speed, reliability, and attention to detail in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities and high standards.




About the Company

Cove Brands is a profitable consumer brand group at the beginning of an ambitious next chapter across beauty, wellness, and home. Our portfolio blends the performance mindset of an e-commerce operator with the creativity of a brand incubator — data-driven, brand-obsessed, and moving quickly into national retail.

We keep our team small, our standards high, and our goals ambitious. Every person here plays a visible role in shaping strategy, creative, and growth — driving measurable impact on the brands we’re building.




Role Details

Location: Remote
Experience: 2–4 years
Education: Bachelor’s degree required; strong academic track record preferred

description:
About the job

Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are… 

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

Your New Role:

The IT Business Analyst is responsible for the planning and execution throughout the lifecycle of one or more software solutions within the business domain. This includes creating and prioritizing product and business requirements and working closely with business and technology teams to ensure business stakeholder and end user satisfaction goals are met. They will create and develop requirements and concepts for product enhancements in support of business and technology needs. This position provides a wide variety of services to our business users including business analysis and quality assurance, in support of strategic and tactical planning of systems features / functionality as well as day to day business operations. The role also entails Project Management for software releases and managing of SOX processes and documentation.

Your Role Accountabilities:


●Collaborate with key business stakeholders to generate business requirements based on use cases/user stories. Prioritize and scope based on business input and ROI.
● Lead collaboration with the global teams to assure incorporation of global requirements for enhancements when prioritized and justified related to regional requirements. Assure no negative impact to global regional workflows.
● Collaborate with internal engineering, vendor engineering, internal technical teams and external technical teams to assure vendor and technical designs cover mandatory business requirements.
● Serve as primary contact for the business for the support of system functionality, business process and workflow and react to emerging or changing revenue opportunities and industry trends.
● Lead proof-of-concept priority projects related to new or adjusted business processes to satisfy industry or business adjustments.
● Participate in assessment and feasibility studies of available technologies and recommend solutions.
● Manage business and functional requirements for one or more business solutions related to Ad Sales Deals, Ad Sales Contracts, Linear and Digital booking and tracking, Content Rights, Scheduling, Traffic, Presentation and Reconciliation operations.
● Manage relationships with multiple business organizations, global technology groups and 3rd party software vendors including: facilitating requirement and design workshops, reviewing designs, test plans and test cases; reviewing vendor deliverables and schedules; managing quality or delivery issues with the vendor; coordinating end user testing and sign-off for in-house and vendor deliverables.

Functional Testing
• Perform functional testing and document workflow and configuration changes related to system and process adjustments based on Proof-of-concept outcomes or business requirements.

Training
● Provide a walk thorough of new functionality including both system functionality and region-specific recommended configuration and workflow. Train the trainer.
● Assist in the design, delivery, and improvement of in-house training programs and related courseware.

Compliance and Standards
● Ensure compliance with Warner Bros. Discovery Software Development Lifecycle documentation and mandated compliance requirements for all application changes.

General

● Work independently under minimal supervision.

Qualifications & Experiences:
• Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, or equivalent degree/work experience
• Experience supporting technology solutions in a Media industry organization
• Minimum of 2 years’ experience with mid to large-scale software development projects – understanding all phases of systems development
• Strong prioritization and organization skills
• Strong presentation and communication skills; excellent listening skills, ability to interface with business customers at all levels of the organization
• Strong project management skills
• Excellent problem solving and analytical skills
• Excellent people skills – negotiation, conflict resolution, providing direction and focus
• Ability to work on multiple projects at one time with minimal supervision and to ensure that overall priorities are being met
• Proven ability to successfully operate within, and contribute to, a high growth, entrepreneurial, fast paced business and matrix environment.

Preferred qualifications
• Experience in Air-Time Sales, Business Intelligence, and Audience Research business areas and respective applications desirable
• Formal Business Analysis Training desirable




How We Get Things Done…

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. description:
About the job

Who You’ll Work With

 

The Research & Insights practice at Slalom is a growing team of roughly 20 researchers spanning qualitative, quantitative, UX, and market research disciplines. We work directly with clients to uncover what their customers want, what their markets are doing, and what their data is saying, so that when organizations move, they move on something real.

We bring human craft and modern tools to every engagement. The result is research that does not stop at the finding, it follows through to the decision, the strategy, and the work that gets done.




What You’ll Do

 

The Research Strategist brings quantitative rigor and qualitative depth to client engagements, designing research that uncovers what customers actually think, do, and need, and translating those findings into strategies organizations can act on.

This role sits at the center of client delivery, owning the research design, leading the analysis, and shaping the so-what. Beyond the research, this person connects insight to decision, decision to strategy, and strategy to action- helping clients move forward with evidence behind them and confidence in front of them. A curiosity about AI in research and synthetic methods is part of how we expect to shape the future. 

 

1) Research Design & Methodology

Select and justify research methods across quantitative and qualitative approaches, with a clear rationale for why one method serves the objective better than another
Design survey instruments with rigorous attention to question architecture, scale selection, skip logic, and sample design to ensure findings are statistically credible & analytically useful
Define research questions, hypotheses, and success criteria at the outset of an engagement to keep the work anchored to business outcomes rather than research process

 

2) Research Execution, Synthesis and Analysis

Design, field, and analyze surveys end-to-end, including segmentation, cross-tabs, and significance testing, translating statistical output into findings a business leader can act on
Design and lead qualitative fieldwork across focus groups, in-depth interviews, and ethnographic methods, bringing a point of view to what is heard, not just a record of it
Synthesize findings across methods into a single, cohesive insight narrative that integrates behavioral, attitudinal, and market data into a complete picture of the customer
Analyze qualitative data with rigor, identifying patterns and tensions in the data rather than simply surfacing themes that confirm the hypothesis
Know when the data is telling you something unexpected and have the analytical confidence to follow it, even when it complicates the story

 

3) Research-to-Action Translation

Translate research findings into strategic recommendations that are specific, prioritized, and tied to a business outcome rather than a restatement of what the data said
Create customer-facing outputs including journey maps, experience diagnostics, and personas grounded in research evidence, then shape the strategic narratives that connect research to the decisions and investments that follow
Frame implications for different audiences, sharpening the so-what for an executive and the so-now-what for a product or delivery team

 

4) Client, Project, & Team Leadership 

 

Manage client expectations around research scope, timeline, and findings, communicating proactively when something in the data or the process requires a change in direction
Hold a methodology position when challenged, articulating the rationale clearly 
Collaborate across disciplines including design, data, strategy, and technology to ensure research findings connect to the broader engagement 
Contribute to internal practice development through knowledge sharing, methodology documentation, and participation in R&I capability building

 

What You’ll Bring

 

Core Skills

Strong quantitative experience: survey design, segmentation, regression, and significance testing
Mixed-methods fluency across qualitative and quantitative research design and execution
Ability to synthesize behavioral, attitudinal, and market data into a clear, structured point of view
Ability to translate research into strategic outputs including personas, journey maps, and segmentation frameworks
Hypothesis-driven thinking with the ability to define precise research questions and stress test assumptions
Clear, structured communication tailored to executive and cross-functional audiences
Intellectual curiosity and genuine interest in where modern research methods and tools are heading

 

Preferred Skills

Persona development, journey mapping, or VoC programs
Social listening, online community research, User Testing, Usability Testing, Market sizing
CX, product, or digital strategy engagements
Familiarity with research tools (e.g., survey platforms, analytics tools)
Ability to work with both ambiguous problems and structured data sets
Familiarity with AI-assisted research methods, synthetic persona development, or simulated customer behavior at any level

 

Typical Background: 4-6 years’ experience in:



Consulting (CX, strategy, or analytics)
Market research or UX research
Product or experience strategy teams
Experience supporting client-facing projects and working across stakeholders

What Success Looks Like

Delivers clear, actionable insights (not just data)
Connects research findings to strategic recommendations
Effectively communicates insights to diverse stakeholders
Delivers research that earns client trust and creates demand for continued engagement
Demonstrates curiosity, rigor, and a strong learning mindset

 

About Us

Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact. 

 

What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days. 

 

Compensation and Benefits

Slalom prides itself on helping team members thrive in their work and life. As a result, Slalom is proud to invest in benefits that include meaningful time off and paid holidays, parental leave, 401(k) with a match, a range of choices for highly subsidized health, dental, & vision coverage, adoption and fertility assistance, and short/long-term disability. We also offer yearly $350 reimbursement account for any well-being-related expenses, as well as discounted home, auto, and pet insurance.

 

EEO and Accommodations

Slalom is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to attracting, developing and retaining highly qualified talent who empower our innovative teams through unique perspectives and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Slalom will also consider qualified applications with criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Slalom welcomes and encourages applications from individuals with disabilities. Reasonable accommodations are available for candidates during all aspects of the selection process. Please advise the talent acquisition team or contact accomodationrequest@slalom.com if you require accommodations during the interview process.

Analytics, Architecture, Artificial Intelligence, Communication, Confidence, Consulting, Curiosity, Customer Experience, Design, Digital Strategy, Documentation, Financial Restatement, Focus Groups, Heading, Intellectual Curiosity, Investments, Knowledge Sharing, Listening, Market Data, Market Research, Persona, Quantitative Research, Research, Research Design, Rigor, Scale, Segmentation, Strategy, Structured Data, Survey Design, Synthesis, Team Leadership, Technology, Testing, Translation, Usability Testing, User Experience, User Testing

This is a hands-on GTM and outbound systems role for someone who can build the structure behind a scalable outbound sales motion while also understanding the realities of cold calling, SDR execution, and staffing-industry sales.

description:
About the job

Company Description

TechLoom Global connects industry-leading companies across various sectors with top-tier global talent. Our expertise spans a wide range of functions, including sales development, product and engineering, marketing, operations, customer success, finance, and administrative support. As a TechLoom Global team member, you become part of a network of high-caliber professionals delivering real impact for forward-thinking companies navigating today's dynamic and competitive landscape.




Role Description

We are seeking a Marketing Generalist to own marketing end-to-end for a fast-moving B2B SaaS company. This is a hands-on operator role — not a strategy role — for someone who can move from copy and design to live deployment and iteration without waiting on approvals or external vendors.




You'll work closely with the founding team in a fully remote, async-first environment, taking full ownership of every marketing touchpoint: the website, social profiles, and sales collateral. There is no committee here — you close the loop yourself, in days, not weeks.




This role is ideal for someone who has a portfolio of real shipped work, not just decks, and who uses AI tools to multiply their own output rather than delegating it away.




Responsibilities

- Own marketing execution end-to-end — copy, design, and live deployment across all channels

- Maintain and iterate the company website (Framer) without relying on developers or agencies

- Design and ship sales collateral, landing pages, and campaign assets independently

- Manage and grow social profiles with consistent, on-brand content

- Plan marketing activity ahead of product launches, working closely with the sales team to support deal closing

- Prioritize speed and shipping — get things live and iterate, rather than seeking perfection before launch

- Use AI tools to accelerate copywriting, design, and production output

- Take full accountability for outcomes across every touchpoint, without deferring to external vendors




Qualifications

- 3–5+ years of experience executing marketing at a B2B SaaS or sales-led company

- A portfolio of actual shipped work — websites, landing pages, campaigns — not strategy decks

- Strong, clear writing skills paired with high design taste

- Proficiency in Figma; experience with Framer strongly preferred

- Proven speed of execution and comfort working without a team or committee

- Demonstrated use of AI tools to multiply personal output

- Proactive mindset — plans ahead of launches rather than reacting to them

- Comfortable being fully accountable for results, with no hand-holding or vendor hand-offs

Hands-on experience with:

 - Website management (Framer or equivalent)

 - Figma or comparable design tools

 - Sales collateral and landing page creation

 - Social media content and profile management

title: Agency Growth Manager (Premium) - TikTok LIVE
description:
About the job

Responsibilities
Team Introduction
The livestream industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become the next growth driver for TikTok global business. It also brings great joy to users globally and it creates a new channel for our creators to show themselves.

Responsibilities
Creators are at the center of our operations. Through professional agencies and MCNs in the content business, especially those that specialize in livestreaming, we are building scale and democratization of the livestreaming business. In this role of Agency Growth Manager, you will carry out two main sets of responsibilities that will drive business growth in a sustainable way:
1. Agency Management
 - Design TikTok LIVE LATAM's agency growth strategy for recruiting, retaining, and helping agencies scale up in their business on the platform. 
 - Design agency's benefit system and growth program to incentivize better performance and sustainable revenue growth.
 - Conduct day-to-day management directly with agency managers and their creators to materialize and iterate the strategic programs to deliver business results. Provide additional support to agencies and their creators for the needs related to content and platform guidelines. 
 - Build LIVE showcases with successful agencies and increase the positive impact of working with the platform in the agency community.
 - Collaborate with internal and cross-functional teams to carry out in-app and out-of-app campaigns and drive participation and results from agency creators.
 - Monitor results metrics for agency growth and performance, and conduct regular analysis to generate operational insights for improvement.
2. Agency Education and Capacity Building
 - Design LIVE's agency empowerment program with practical tips and know-how about how to scale up agency's operation and revenue potential with a focus on agency professionalization.
 - Facilitate business and industry knowledge transfer from top agencies to emerging agencies, learn from global best practices and localize the expertise to educate local agencies on how to scale.
 - Share the platform know-how on content tips and trends to agencies to improve their creators' LIVE performance and revenue generation.
 - Conduct training to agencies for the above mentioned topics, leveraging different tools and social platforms.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree or above.
- More than 2 years of working experience relates to creator management, especially managing influencer agencies and/or MCNs.
- Candidates who are sensitive to cultural trends, possess a good understanding of the content industry, creator economy and business acumen on newly emerged industries are preferred. 
- Professional, patient, and skillful communication with talents/influencers. 
- Result-oriented and data-driven operation.
- Proficient in both verbal and written English and Spanish due to communication with global team in English and local team in Spanish

Preferred Qualifications
- Candidates who are used to work with, or have connections with modeling, content, media, TV, celebrities, and livestreaming platforms. 



About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.


TikTok Accommodation
TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request

Are you interested in launching or growing your career in digital marketing? The WITHIN team is expanding, and we’re looking for a Digital Media Buyer Trainee to support our efforts across multiple marketing channels. This role offers an opportunity to gain hands-on experience and develop expertise in key areas of digital marketing, including Paid Social, Paid Search, Programmatic, Email Marketing, Affiliate Marketing, Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Influencer Marketing, and Retail Media.

Paid Social: Learn how to create and manage paid social campaigns on platforms like Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn, focusing on targeting, budgeting, and performance analysis to drive engagement and conversions.

Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.

description:
About the job

Una de las decisiones más emocionantes y significativas en la vida es elegir dónde vas a vivir. Por eso creamos EasyBroker: para darle a los asesores inmobiliarios las herramientas que necesitan para prosperar y ofrecer un servicio excepcional, haciendo que comprar o rentar sea simple y sin estrés. Hoy apoyamos a más de 15,000 profesionales, con más de 500,000 propiedades y más de 3,000 sitios web creados con nuestra plataforma.

Aunque empezamos en 2007, trabajamos como una startup: equipo pequeño, remoto, muy talentoso y con un enfoque radical en crear productos que importan. Valoramos el criterio, el buen gusto, la autonomía y la capacidad de llevar proyectos de principio a fin. Aquí no eres una pieza más: das forma a las ideas, hablas con usuarios cuando hace falta, propones soluciones y tienes un impacto real en el producto y en el negocio.

Ahora estamos apostando fuerte por Pincali, nuestro nuevo marketplace con el que queremos convertirnos en el mejor lugar para comprar o rentar tu hogar en México. Es un proyecto ambicioso diseñado para crecer rápido: nuestra meta es multiplicar por diez los ingresos en tres años. Y, a diferencia de muchas startups, tenemos algo que prácticamente nadie más tiene:


17 años de experiencia profunda en el sector.
Una red enorme de asesores inmobiliarios gracias a EasyBroker.
Un equipo de producto y tecnología muy bueno.
Los recursos para financiar y construir Pincali nosotros mismos, sin inversión externa.


Eso nos coloca en una posición extraordinaria: tenemos una probabilidad muy alta de que Pincali sea un éxito masivo. Y quienes se unan ahora tendrán la oportunidad de crecer junto con el proyecto y beneficiarse directamente del impacto que generen. Es una de esas ventanas únicas donde el riesgo es bajo y el potencial es extremadamente alto.

Si te inspira la idea de construir algo grande, asumir verdadera responsabilidad y trabajar con gente talentosa en un producto con enorme potencial, aquí puedes hacer el mejor trabajo de tu carrera. Queremos que quienes se unan ahora crezcan tanto como la empresa y que se beneficien de manera importante del éxito que estamos construyendo juntos.

¿Cómo nos ayudarás a cumplir nuestra misión?

EasyBroker llegó hasta donde está en gran medida porque los agentes inmobiliarios se lo recomiendan entre sí. Detrás de eso hay un equipo que conoce de cerca el reto de ser agente inmobiliario en México: sus presiones, su forma de trabajar y lo que necesitan para hacer crecer su negocio. Nuestro equipo de Customer Success convierte ese conocimiento en confianza, y esa confianza en lealtad.

Resolverás dudas técnicas, investigarás problemas complejos y ayudarás a identificar oportunidades de mejora para el producto. A veces eso implicará revisar configuraciones avanzadas o entender qué está ocurriendo dentro de un sitio web; otras, detectar que un problema reportado por un usuario en realidad refleja una necesidad más amplia que vale la pena escalar al resto del equipo.

Trabajarás en un equipo de Customer Success de cuatro personas con seniority, incluyendo a tu manager, la Head de Customer Success. También trabajarás muy cerca del equipo de Engineering, Product y Marketing, representando la voz del usuario dentro de EasyBroker de forma clara y fundamentada, transformando conversaciones cotidianas en mejoras reales para el producto y la experiencia de nuestros clientes.

En este rol, hacer las preguntas correctas es tan importante como dar las respuestas. Esperamos que investigues cuando algo no esté claro, que conectes información de distintas fuentes y que llegues con propuestas concretas para resolver problemas antes de que crezcan.

Buscamos personas curiosas, con criterio, capacidad técnica y mucha iniciativa. Personas capaces de desenvolverse en conversaciones complejas, identificar la necesidad detrás de una consulta y construir soluciones prácticas incluso cuando el problema no está completamente definido.

skills: Salesforce Delivery Ownership: You own the "how" of the Salesforce build — data model, automation (Flows + Apex), UI (LWC/screen flows), permission sets, Record Types, and packaging — from detailed technical design through deployment.

Platform-Level Design Authority: You are the guardian of the org's data model and automation architecture. Schema changes, sharing/visibility, and process design go through you, and you keep them coherent as the solution grows.

Engineering Rigor & Quality: You enforce production-grade Salesforce standards — Apex test coverage ≥ the org bar, FLS/sharing correctness, governor-limit awareness, and metadata/CLI-based deployment (SFDX/`sf`).

Integration Contract Ownership: You define and protect the API/data contracts between Salesforce and the backend integration services (identity validation, CRM sync, e-signature, and the SFCC B2B commerce component). You coordinate — not necessarily hand-build — the non-Salesforce layers, ensuring changes stay backward-compatible.

Proactive Risk Management: You surface dependencies, scope creep, and technical debt before they block delivery — especially coupling between the org schema, its automations, and the services that consume them — and bring solutions, not just problems.

Communication & Alignment: You translate Salesforce platform constraints (limits, callout/identity constraints, packaging realities) into plain language for non-technical PMs and client stakeholders, and keep engineering, PM, and design aligned on decisions and status.

Engineering Leadership & Mentorship: You lead and mentor Salesforce (and adjacent) engineers through technical reviews, coaching, and hands-on support, fostering a psychologically safe, high-accountability, high-quality culture.

Proven Salesforce Technical Leadership: A significant track record (Senior/Lead level) delivering complex Salesforce Platform (Sales/Service Cloud, Core CRM) projects and supporting them in production. You can take a vague goal and turn it into shipped, stable org configuration and code.
Deep Salesforce Platform Expertise (hands-on):
Apex (triggers, services, async, test classes) and governor-limit-aware design.
Flows — record-triggered and screen flows — as a first-class automation tool.
LWC for custom UI where declarative isn't enough.
Data model & security: custom objects, Record Types, permission sets/permission-set groups, FLS, sharing.
Deployment & ALM: SFDX source format, metadata/CLI deployment (`sf`), sandboxes, change/branching strategy, CI-based deploys.
Integration surface: REST/Apex callouts, Connected Apps & OAuth 2.0 (incl. M2M client-credentials), Platform Events/outbound patterns.

Integration & Cloud Awareness (coordinate, not necessarily build): Enough fluency in API-based integrations and a cloud/microservice backend (Node/NestJS on AWS is the current stack, including an SFCC B2B commerce component) to own the contracts and reason about the end-to-end flow. Deep AWS/Terraform/backend build experience is a plus, not a requirement.

Multi-Workstream & Multi-Party Delivery: Comfortable running structured build and live operational/support work in parallel, and aligning technical direction across agency, client, and corporate platform teams within a controlled, security-gated environment.
Communication: Excellent English (written and verbal); Spanish strongly preferred for day-to-day work with a Chile-based client and team.
People Leadership & Mentorship: Proven experience leading and mentoring engineers through coaching, technical guidance, and constructive feedback.

Domain exposure to financial services, credit bureau, or identity/KYC onboarding flows, and comfort in regulated / enterprise-security contexts (VPN, corporate proxies, restricted egress, DevSecOps gates).

Candidates located in Santiago, Chile are able to work out of our Santiago office as remote/hybrid employees. Candidates located outside of Santiago, Chile will be fully remote employees.

 THE ROLE: 

The Tech Lead is the single technical owner accountable for the successful delivery of a Salesforce-centric digital onboarding platform built for a global credit-bureau client. Salesforce is the heart of the solution — it orchestrates the entire B2B registration and onboarding journey: lead capture, identity-validation outcomes, disposition logic, and contract e-signature. You own the Salesforce build end to end and keep it aligned with the surrounding integration and infrastructure layers.

This is a high-autonomy role and the sole senior Salesforce voice on the engagement. You take architectural direction and turn it into shipped, production-grade Salesforce metadata — objects, Record Types, Flows, Apex, LWC, permission model, and managed-package configuration (DocuSign eSignature). You also hold the technical relationship with the integration microservices and cloud platform that read from and write to the org: you don't build those daily, but you define the contracts, guard the data model, and make sure a schema or automation change never blindsides them.

Here is the truth: this is a Salesforce Platform (Core/CRM) role. We're looking for a builder who lives in the Salesforce org — declarative and programmatic — and who is senior enough to own the platform-level decisions that everything else depends on.

RESPONSIBILITIES:


Salesforce Delivery Ownership: You own the "how" of the Salesforce build — data model, automation (Flows + Apex), UI (LWC/screen flows), permission sets, Record Types, and packaging — from detailed technical design through deployment. 
Platform-Level Design Authority: You are the guardian of the org's data model and automation architecture. Schema changes, sharing/visibility, and process design go through you, and you keep them coherent as the solution grows. 
Engineering Rigor & Quality: You enforce production-grade Salesforce standards — Apex test coverage ≥ the org bar, FLS/sharing correctness, governor-limit awareness, and metadata/CLI-based deployment (SFDX/`sf`). 
Integration Contract Ownership: You define and protect the API/data contracts between Salesforce and the backend integration services (identity validation, CRM sync, e-signature, and the SFCC B2B commerce component). You coordinate — not necessarily hand-build — the non-Salesforce layers, ensuring changes stay backward-compatible. 
Proactive Risk Management: You surface dependencies, scope creep, and technical debt before they block delivery — especially coupling between the org schema, its automations, and the services that consume them — and bring solutions, not just problems. 
Communication & Alignment: You translate Salesforce platform constraints (limits, callout/identity constraints, packaging realities) into plain language for non-technical PMs and client stakeholders, and keep engineering, PM, and design aligned on decisions and status. 
Engineering Leadership & Mentorship: You lead and mentor Salesforce (and adjacent) engineers through technical reviews, coaching, and hands-on support, fostering a psychologically safe, high-accountability, high-quality culture. 


REQUIREMENTS: 


Proven Salesforce Technical Leadership: A significant track record (Senior/Lead level) delivering complex Salesforce Platform (Sales/Service Cloud, Core CRM) projects and supporting them in production. You can take a vague goal and turn it into shipped, stable org configuration and code. 
Deep Salesforce Platform Expertise (hands-on):
Apex (triggers, services, async, test classes) and governor-limit-aware design. 
Flows — record-triggered and screen flows — as a first-class automation tool. 
LWC for custom UI where declarative isn't enough. 
Data model & security: custom objects, Record Types, permission sets/permission-set groups, FLS, sharing. 
Deployment & ALM: SFDX source format, metadata/CLI deployment (`sf`), sandboxes, change/branching strategy, CI-based deploys. 
Integration surface: REST/Apex callouts, Connected Apps & OAuth 2.0 (incl. M2M client-credentials), Platform Events/outbound patterns. 
Integration & Cloud Awareness (coordinate, not necessarily build): Enough fluency in API-based integrations and a cloud/microservice backend (Node/NestJS on AWS is the current stack, including an SFCC B2B commerce component) to own the contracts and reason about the end-to-end flow. Deep AWS/Terraform/backend build experience is a plus, not a requirement. 
Multi-Workstream & Multi-Party Delivery: Comfortable running structured build and live operational/support work in parallel, and aligning technical direction across agency, client, and corporate platform teams within a controlled, security-gated environment. 
Communication: Excellent English (written and verbal); Spanish strongly preferred for day-to-day work with a Chile-based client and team. 
People Leadership & Mentorship: Proven experience leading and mentoring engineers through coaching, technical guidance, and constructive feedback. 


NICE TO HAVE:


Salesforce certifications: Platform Developer I/II, App Builder, and/or an Architect-track credential. 
Familiarity with test-driven development (TDD) / high-coverage delivery as a working practice. 
DocuSign eSignature for Salesforce (or comparable managed-package e-signature) configuration experience. 
Domain exposure to financial services, credit bureau, or identity/KYC onboarding flows, and comfort in regulated / enterprise-security contexts (VPN, corporate proxies, restricted egress, DevSecOps gates). 
Familiarity with Node.js/NestJS, AWS (ECS Fargate), Terraform, Okta/SSO, and Jenkins/Bitbucket CI/CD as the surrounding platform. 
CMS-driven frontends (Next.js / Contentful) exposure.

Role: Web Browsing Analyst (Remote)
Location: Remote (Work from Anywhere)
Job Type: Contract

Role Overview:

We are hiring for one of our clients, seeking a Web Browsing Evaluator to work on a contract basis. The role involves assessing the quality, relevance, and accuracy of web search results and browsing experiences. Evaluators will follow detailed guidelines to provide feedback on search engine performance and user interface effectiveness.




Key Responsibilities:

• Assess the relevance and accuracy of web search results based on specific queries and user intent.

• Evaluate the quality of web pages, including content accuracy, usability, and adherence to search engine guidelines.

• Provide detailed feedback on the browsing experience, including page load times, navigation, and overall user satisfaction.

• Identify and report issues such as broken links, outdated content, or misleading information in search results.

• Follow structured evaluation guidelines to ensure consistency and reliability in assessments.




Required Skills & Qualifications:

• Demonstrated ability to follow detailed written instructions and provide constructive feedback.

• Familiarity with web browsing, search engines, and basic understanding of how search algorithms function.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to evaluate content for accuracy and relevance.

• Basic computer literacy and proficiency in using web browsers.

• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in a remote setting.




More About the Opportunity:

This role offers a unique opportunity to work with a global leader in the Technology, Information and Internet industry, contributing to the improvement of search engine accuracy and user experience. Evaluators play a critical role in refining how information is delivered to users worldwide.




Equal Opportunity Employer:

We hire based on skills and expertise. All qualified candidates are welcome regardless of background, experience, or prior employment history. Applications are reviewed solely on demonstrated technical ability and qualifications.




Apply Now!

About the job

About Remote

Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.

With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role.

We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.

If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

About Remote

Remote is solving the biggest challenge in modern business: building and scaling global teams. We enable companies to employ anyone, anywhere compliantly, while simplifying payroll, benefits, taxes, and HR. Our mission is to create opportunity everywhere — and storytelling plays a critical role in making that real.

What You’ll Do

Define and evolve Remote’s brand voice

Shape a distinctive, consistent voice that reflects Remote’s clarity, confidence, and global perspective. Establish tone and editorial standards that scale across campaigns and our website.

Own creative campaign storytelling end-to-end

Lead messaging and writing for creative campaigns — from big ideas and narratives to execution across channels. Develop work that is memorable, differentiated, and deeply aligned with our audience.

Elevate the Remote website

Write and optimize high-impact website content that clearly communicates our value, simplifies complex topics, and drives conversion. Continuously refine messaging based on performance and audience insight.

Create scalable content systems

Develop repeatable formats, messaging frameworks, and modular content that can be reused and adapted across campaigns and web experiences.

Turn attention into action

Craft content that doesn’t just inform — it moves people. Help transform visitors into customers, and customers into advocates through compelling, conversion-oriented storytelling.

Experiment and push the brand forward

Explore new formats, channels, and creative approaches. Bring fresh, modern storytelling techniques into Remote’s brand ecosystem.

Scale with AI (thoughtfully)

Leverage AI to increase speed, consistency, and creative ambition — while maintaining a strong editorial point of view and human quality bar.

Collaborate across Remote

Partner with marketing, product, design, and leadership to bring sharp, differentiated perspectives to life. Translate complex global employment topics into clear, engaging narratives.

Raise the bar for brand writing

Set a high standard for craft, clarity, and creativity. Continuously improve how we tell Remote’s story across every touchpoint.

What You Bring


Proven experience writing high-quality brand and marketing content across formats — especially creative campaigns and web
Exceptional writing and editing skills, with a strong sense of voice, tone, and narrative structure
Strong editorial judgment, including knowing what not to create
Experience translating complex topics into clear, engaging, and accessible content
Deep understanding of modern content patterns (clarity, structure, flow, and conversion principles)
A clear perspective on how AI can enhance content creation
Track record of driving measurable impact through content (brand, engagement, and conversion)
Ability to collaborate cross-functionally and influence stakeholders
Experience in HR tech, SaaS, or fintech — or strong curiosity about the future of work and global employment



Why This Role Matters

This role sits at the heart of how Remote shows up in the world. You’ll help define how we tell our story — making complex global employment feel simple, human, and compelling. Your work will shape first impressions, drive growth, and build a brand that companies trust as they expand globally.

Application process


Interview with recruiter
Interview with future manager
Interview with team members 
Bar Raiser Interview
Prior employment verification check 



Remote's Total Rewards philosophy is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair equity pay along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate. We do not agree to or encourage cheap-labor practices and therefore we ensure to pay above in-location rates. We hope to inspire other companies to support global talent-hiring and bring local wealth to developing countries.

At first glance our salary bands seem quite wide - here is some context. At Remote we have international operations and a globally distributed workforce. We use geo ranges to consider geographic pay differentials as part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive in various markets while we hiring globally.

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay for the successful candidate in this role is dependent upon many factors such as location, transferable or job-related skills, work experience, relevant training, business needs, and market demands. The base salary range may be subject to change.

At Remote, we foster internal mobility as a key element of our culture of employee growth and development, supported by a compensation philosophy that guarantees pay equity and fairness. Therefore, all compensation changes associated with an internal move will be reviewed by the Total Rewards & People Enablement team on a case by case basis.

The annual salary range for this full-time position is

$90,000—$120,000 USD

Benefits

Our full benefits & perks are explained in our handbook at remote.com/r/benefits. As a global company, each country works differently, but some benefits/perks are for all Remoters:


work from anywhere
flexible paid time off
flexible working hours (we are async)
16 weeks paid parental leave
mental health support services
stock options
learning budget
home office budget & IT equipment
budget for local in-person social events or co-working spaces



How You’ll Plan Your Day (and Life)

We work async at Remote which means you can plan your schedule around your life (and not around meetings). Read more at remote.com/async.

You will be empowered to take ownership and be proactive. When in doubt you will default to action instead of waiting. Your life-work balance is important and you will be encouraged to put yourself and your family first, and fit work around your needs.

If that sounds like something you want, apply now!

How To Apply

Not only do we encourage folks from all ethnic groups, genders, sexuality, age, abilities, disability status and any other under-represented group to apply, but we prioritize a sense of belonging. During your interviews and beyond, we ask & encourage anybody who needs an accommodation to request one from their recruiter.

We will ask you to voluntarily tell us your pronouns at interview stage, and you will have the option to answer our anonymous demographic questionnaire when you apply below. As an equal employment opportunity employer it’s important to us that our workforce reflects people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences and this data will help us to stay accountable. We thank you for providing this data, if you chose to.
